task.title: Implement an analytics-retention candidate/coverage planner
task.input: receivedAt/expiresAt rules, analytics-aggregate coverage and section 09 retention parameters
task.output: analytics-retention-plan; pure cutoff calculation and a read-only candidate repository
task.accept: 1) With an injected clock verify receivedAt plus 30 days, 13-calendar-month expiresAt boundaries and equality-at-expiry. Read-only queries return candidate IDs/counts without deleting data or exporting browserHash/business PII. 2) The planner also returns the start of complete raw coverage/non-recomputable natural days; partially cleaned days cannot be marked recomputable. M5-T11 consumes this output and integrates real transactions/production-authorization gates.
